name: Sikafloor-400 N Elastic
paste:
SIKAFLOOR®-400 N ELASTIC: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sikafloor®-400 N Elastic, April 2023, Version 04.01 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/w/sikafloor_-400_nelastic.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sikafloor®-400 N Elastic where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 04.01).
1.2 Product description. Sikafloor®-400 N Elastic is a one part, highly elastic, solvent containing, UV resistant, coloured, moisture curing polyurethane resin coating.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. Sikafloor®-400 N Elastic may only be used by experienced professionals. Sikafloor®-400 N Elastic is used for:
    - Exposed roof decks terraces, gutters, flashings, walls
    - Balconies
    - Light to medium mechanical exposure
    - Heavy foot traffic
    - Footbridges, stairways etc.
    - Podium Decks
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.9.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sikafloor®-400 N Elastic
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Sikafloor-400 N Elastic is a one-component, UV resistant, highly elastic, moisture curing polyurethane waterproof membrane.
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals / certificates.
    - BRANZ Test Report: DC11037-001: AS4654.1 2012: Meets requirements as a Class II Membrane: Heavy Duty System
    - Synthetic resin screed material for floor screeds according to EN 13813:2002, Declaration of Performance 0208050100100000011008, certified by notified factory production control body 0921 and provided with the CE mark
    - Coating for concrete protection according to EN 1504-2:2004, Declaration of Performance 0208050100100000011008, certified by notified factory production control body 0921 and provided with the CE mark
    - Approval for “Ground Water Protection System”, Z- 59.12-4, DIBt, Germany, July 2008.
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - AS4654.1: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Approvals / Certificates (p.1).
    - EN 13813:2002: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Approvals / Certificates (p.1).
    - EN 1504-2:2004: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Approvals / Certificates (p.1).
    - DIN EN ISO 2811-1: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Product Information > Density (p.2).
    - DIN 53109: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Abrasion resistance (p.2).
    - DIN 53504: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Tensile strain at break (p.2).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Highly elastic
    - Crack-bridging
    - Waterproof
    - UV resistant, non-yellowing
    - Weather resistant
    - Abrasion resistant with normal use
    - Slip resistant surfaces are possible
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: Polyurethane
    - Density: ~ 1.6 kg/l (DIN EN ISO 2811-1)
2.6 Appearance and colour. Standard colours in stock: Stone Grey RAL 7030, Koala Grey N45, Light Grey RAL 7035; Other colours availble upon request on a Made To Order basis: Grey White RAL 9002, Slate Grey RAL 7015, Dusty Grey RAL 7037, Window Grey RAL 7040, Traffic White RAL 9016, Dahlia Yellow RAL 1033. Please speak to us for other colours.
2.7 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Solid content by mass: ~ 88 %
    - Solid content by volume: ~ 77 %
2.8 Abrasion resistance.
    | 30 mg (CS 10/1000/1000) | (8 days / +23 °C) |
    Test method printed: (DIN 53109)
2.9 Tensile strain at break.
    | At +23 °C | ~320 % |
    | At -20 °C | ~70 % |
    Test method printed: (DIN 53504)
2.10 Temperature resistance.
    | Exposure* | Dry heat |
    | Permanent | +50 °C |
    | Short-term max. 7d | +80 °C |
    | Short-term max. 8h | +100 °C |
    *No simultaneous chemical and mechanical exposure.
2.11 Chemical resistance. Resistant to many chemicals. Contact Sika technical service. Attention: Wine, coffee, some leaves and flower petals etc. may cause surface discolouration. This will have no effect on the product performance and durability.
2.12 Systems. Light Pedestrian Traffic: 1.1mm - 1.2mm Thickness
    | Product | Consumption |
    | Sikafloor 400N (+ 10% Thinner C) | 0.6kg/m2 (375um) |
    | Sikafloor 400N | 0.6kg/m2 (375um) |
    | Sikafloor 400N | 0.6kg/m2 (375um) |
    | Heavy Pedestrian Traffic: 1.8mm - 2.0mm Thickness |
    | Product | Consumption |
    | Sikafloor 161 (Epoxy Primer) | 0.5kg/m2 (350um) |
    | Sikafloor 400N | 1.6kg/m2 (1000um) |
    | Sikafloor 400N | 0.5kg/m2 (310um) |
    | Broadcast Quartz Sand (0.4 - 0.7mm) | 1.5-2.0kg/m2 |
    | Sikafloor 400N | 1.0kg/m2 (625um) |
    | Decorative Flake Flooring System, Please see system data sheet: Sikafloor MonoFlex MB 24 |
    (System build-up table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows. Refer to the data sheet (page 2) for the layout.)
2.13 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: 18 kg units - 11.25 litres
    - Shelf life: 9 months from date of production
    - Storage conditions: The packaging must be stored properly in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging, in dry conditions at temperatures between +5 °C and +30 °C.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 General. Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 04.01) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.
3.2 Substrate quality / pre-treatment. The surface must be clean, dry and free of all contaminants such as dirt, oil, grease, coatings and surface treatments. All dust, loose and friable material must be completely removed from all surfaces before application of the product, preferably by vacuum. Pull of strength shall not be less than 1.5 N/mm². If in doubt apply a test area first.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 04.01) and the requirements below.
4.2 Pot Life. The material in opened containers should be applied immediately. With open containers surface film formation will happen within 1-2 hours. High temperatures and high air humidity will accelerate curing significantly.
4.3 Curing time. Before overcoating Sikafloor®-400 N Elastic allow:
    | Substrate temperature | Minimum | Maximum |
    | +10 °C | 36 hours | 5 days |
    | +20 °C | 24 hours | 3 days |
    | +30 °C | 16 hours | 2 days |
    Times are approximate and will be affected by changing ambient conditions particularly temperature and relative humidity.
4.4 Applied product ready for use.
    | Temperature (r.h. | Rain resistant | Foot traffic | Full cure |
    | 50%) |
    | +10 °C | ~15 hours | ~1 - 2 days* | ~7 - 14 days* |
    | +20 °C | ~5 hours | ~6 - 24 hours* | ~5 - 9 days* |
    | +30 °C | ~3 hours | ~4 - 18 hours* | ~3 - 5 days* |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
    *Strongly influenced by layer thickness
    Note: Times are approximate and will be affected by changing ambient conditions
4.5 Mixing. Prior to use stir Sikafloor®-400 N Elastic mechanically for 3 minutes. If required the Thinner C or Extender T should be added into the Sikafloor®-400 N Elastic until a uniform mix has been achieved. Over mixing must be avoided to minimise air entrainment.
4.6 Mixing - Mixing Tools. Sikafloor®-400 N Elastic must be thoroughly mixed using a low speed electric stirrer (300 - 400 rpm) or other suitable equipment.
4.7 Application.
    - Prior to application, confirm substrate moisture content, relative humidity and dew point.
    - As a primer Sikafloor®-400 N Elastic is diluted by 10% with Thinner C, applied by brush, roller or squeegee and as a coating Sikafloor®-400 N Elastic is poured and spread evenly with a trowel.
4.8 Cleaning of equipment. Clean all tools and application equipment with Thinner C immediately after use. Hardened and/or cured material can only be removed mechanically.
4.9 Limitations and important considerations.
    - Do not apply Sikafloor®-400 N Elastic on substrates with rising moisture. Freshly applied Sikafloor®-400 N Elastic must be protected from damp, condensation and water for at least 24 hours. Prior to overcoating with Sikafloor®-400 N Elastic, the priming coats must have cured tack-free. Always apply during falling temperatures. If applied during rising temperatures “pin holing” may occur from rising air. The incorrect assessment and treatment of cracks may lead to a reduced service life and reflective cracking.
    - For exact colour matching, ensure the Sikafloor®-400 N Elastic in each area is applied from the same control batch numbers. Under certain conditions high ambient temperatures combined with high point loading may lead to imprints in the resin. If heating is required do not use gas, oil, paraffin or other fossil fuel heaters, these produce large quantities of both CO2 and H2O water vapour, which may adversely affect the finish. For heating use only electric powered warm air blower systems.
4.10 Further information.
    - Substrate quality & Preparation
    - Please refer to Sika Method Statement: “EVALUATION AND PREPARATION OF SURFACES FOR FLOORING SYSTEMS”.
    - Application instructions
    - Please refer to Sika Method Statement: “MIXING & APPLICATION OF FLOORING SYSTEMS”.
    - Maintenance
    - Please refer to “Sikafloor®- CLEANING REGIME”.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Ambient air temperature. +10 °C min. / +30 °C max.
5.3 Relative air humidity. 80 % r.h. max. 35 % min. (below +20 °C: 45 % min.)
5.4 Dew point. Beware of condensation! The substrate and uncured floor must be at least 3 °C above dew point to reduce the risk of condensation or blooming on the floor finish.
5.5 Substrate temperature. +10 °C min. / +30 °C max.
5.6 Substrate moisture content. < 4 % pbw moisture content. Test method: Sika®-Tramex meter, CM - measurement or Oven-dry-method. No rising moisture according to ASTM (Polyethylene sheet). Use Sikafloor 161 for moisture to 6%pbw
5.7 Conditions stated in the limitations. Also stated in the data sheet limitations (clause 4.9):
    - Do not apply Sikafloor®-400 N Elastic on substrates with rising moisture. Freshly applied Sikafloor®-400 N Elastic must be protected from damp, condensation and water for at least 24 hours. Prior to overcoating with Sikafloor®-400 N Elastic, the priming coats must have cured tack-free. Always apply during falling temperatures. If applied during rising temperatures “pin holing” may occur from rising air. The incorrect assessment and treatment of cracks may lead to a reduced service life and reflective cracking.
    - For exact colour matching, ensure the Sikafloor®-400 N Elastic in each area is applied from the same control batch numbers. Under certain conditions high ambient temperatures combined with high point loading may lead to imprints in the resin. If heating is required do not use gas, oil, paraffin or other fossil fuel heaters, these produce large quantities of both CO2 and H2O water vapour, which may adversely affect the finish. For heating use only electric powered warm air blower systems.
5.8 Trials, test areas and compatibility checks stated by the manufacturer.
    - The surface must be clean, dry and free of all contaminants such as dirt, oil, grease, coatings and surface treatments. All dust, loose and friable material must be completely removed from all surfaces before application of the product, preferably by vacuum. Pull of strength shall not be less than 1.5 N/mm². If in doubt apply a test area first.
5.9 Test methods printed beside stated values. Each value is as printed in the data sheet with its test method.
    - Density: ~ 1.6 kg/l (DIN EN ISO 2811-1)
    - Abrasion resistance: 30 mg (CS 10/1000/1000) | (8 days / +23 °C) (DIN 53109)
    - Tensile strain at break: At +23 °C | ~320 %; At -20 °C | ~70 % (DIN 53504)
5.10 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.11 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sikafloor®-400 N Elastic, April 2023, Version 04.01, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/w/sikafloor_-400_nelastic.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Sikafloor®-400 N Elastic NZ substrate, version 08/03/2026, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/g/sds-sikafloor-400nelasticnzsubstrate.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Sikafloor®-400 N Elastic, version 08/03/2026, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/m/sds-sikafloor-400nelastic.pdf
    - Brochure: SikaFloor: Resin Flooring Solutions, version 08/11/2023, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/l/Sikafloor%20Resin%20BROCHURE%202023%20FIN%20DIGI.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
